_about: Prices read from AWS pages. 'page-example' means the number is printed in a pricing example on the page, because the page's rate table is not in the text a page reader gets; it is not confirmed as the current table rate. Nothing here is a quote. Recheck every row before relying on it.

fargate_gb_second.description: Fargate Linux/x86 per GB-second of memory

interface_endpoint_hour.description: Interface VPC endpoint, per endpoint network interface (one zone) per hour

interface_endpoint_gb.description: Interface endpoint data processed, first tier

secret_month.description: Secrets Manager, per secret per month

budget_action_day.description: AWS Budgets, each action-enabled budget beyond the first two (alert-only budgets are free; this design has no actions)

nat_gateway_hour.description: NAT gateway per hour (comparison only; the design has none)
nat_gateway_hour.region: us-east-2 (as printed; us-east-1 not in the text)

public_ipv4_hour.description: Public IPv4 address per hour (comparison only; the design has none)

not_priced: S3 storage and requests (the US East price table could not be read)
Data transfer to or from the internet and between zones
ECS Exec and SSM Session Manager
VPC, subnet, route table and security groups, and the S3 gateway endpoint (believed free; not verified)
Secrets Manager API calls (the example price is $0.05 per 10,000 calls; the count is not estimated)
Free Tier and credits (new accounts: the Secrets Manager page says up to $200 in credits from 2025-07-15; eligibility and expiry not verified). None is applied in any estimate.
Taxes, support plans, and any price change after the date read
